lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct vertical line segments visible on the lateral torso; spacing is dense in the mid-section and increases toward the anterior shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One prominent Y-shaped bifurcation located on the 7th line from the posterior at the vertical midpoint of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Shortened, dashed segments observed on the posterior haunch and near the dorsal crest where lines do not traverse the full torso height.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Group of 5 distinct white spots located on the lower posterior haunch with moderate density.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A triad of spots on the mid-posterior haunch aligns in a diagonal orientation toward the hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature; base vectors orient dorsolaterally followed by a medial and anterior turn at the distal third.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Tip-to-tip pixel distance is approximately 4.8 times the width of the horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping accounts for approximately 0.08 of the total horn structure length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white dorsal spinal crest and extensive dark ventral pelage fringe; high-contrast tan/orange coloration on lower extremities.
